name: Captcha
description: Stops spam and bots on every form of the site with Cloudflare Turnstile or Google reCAPTCHA: sign-in, sign-up, lost password, comments, the Forms plugin, the shop's checkout and the forms of Fresco Pro and Prisma. One place for the keys, a choice of forms, trusted addresses and a failsafe when Cloudflare is down.
author: Cleitext
